# 00000004325

**English.** Definition: The Coates-Wiles homomorphism is the homomorphism from cyclotomic units to the Galois group. Conjecture: Its kernel is the cyclic group generated by p-th power units, and the generator exponent is given by an explicit residue of the class number modulo p. (cyclic generation formula of the CW kernel)

**中文。** 定义：Coates–Wiles 同态指分圆单位到伽罗瓦群的同态。猜想：其核由 p 次单位生成的循环群构成,生成元指数由类数模 p 的显式余式给出。（CW 核循环生成公式）
